input.quote: 14. TERMINATION. Subject to Section 4 hereof, TrueLink will continue to provide the requested Hosting Services and Support Services until the last day of the month following the month in which Client provides TrueLink with a written notice of its election to terminate this Agreement.
input.rationale: Section 14 only implies a Client exit (services continue "until the last day of the month following" our notice) rather than granting an express termination-for-convenience right, sets an uncertain notice period of up to ~60 days, and provides no refund of prepaid fees. Nothing states that TrueLink may not walk away mid-term, and Section 13 lets TrueLink exit at renewal on only 30 days' notice, which is below the playbook floor of 90 days and inconsistent with the 60-day migration window Section 13 imposes on us. Redline makes our 30-day convenience right and prepaid-fee refund explicit, bars TrueLink's mid-term convenience termination, and extends TrueLink's non-renewal notice to 90 days while preserving our 30-day non-renewal notice.

ops.oldText: 14. TERMINATION. Subject to Section 4 hereof, TrueLink will continue to provide the requested Hosting Services and Support Services until the last day of the month following the month in which Client provides TrueLink with a written notice of its election to terminate this Agreement.
ops.newText: 14. TERMINATION. Client may terminate this Agreement for convenience, in whole or in part, at any time upon thirty (30) days' prior written notice to TrueLink, without penalty or early termination fee, in which case TrueLink shall refund any prepaid fees for the period after the effective date of termination. Subject to Section 4 hereof, TrueLink will continue to provide the requested Hosting Services and Support Services through the effective date of termination. TrueLink shall have no right to terminate this Agreement for convenience during the then-current term.

ops.oldText: unless either Client or TrueLink deliver to the other written notice of intent not to renew no later than thirty (30) days prior to the end of said year
ops.newText: unless Client delivers to TrueLink written notice of intent not to renew no later than thirty (30) days prior to the end of said year, or TrueLink delivers to Client written notice of intent not to renew no later than ninety (90) days prior to the end of said year

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have made our termination right explicit: Client may terminate for convenience on 30 days' notice with a refund of prepaid fees and no penalty, and TrueLink has no mid-term convenience right. We also lengthened TrueLink's non-renewal notice to 90 days so we have time to migrate hosting (Section 13 already requires us to arrange a new environment within 60 days), leaving our own 30-day non-renewal notice unchanged.
proposal.summary: Add express Client termination for convenience on 30 days' notice with prepaid-fee refund; bar TrueLink mid-term convenience termination; extend TrueLink's non-renewal notice to 90 days.
